_comment: PUBLIC Ed25519 publisher keys trusted to sign update manifests, by key_id. While this map is empty the signed-manifest updater (core/updater) is FAIL-CLOSED: it offers and installs nothing. Generate a pair with: python -m installer.gen_publisher_keypair --key-id <id> --out-dir <dir-outside-repo>, then pin the printed public hex here. The private half must never live in this repository.
